subject: [PATCH v3 7/8] nfsd: check a fine-grained time before clamping a delegated mtime

2026-11-09.patch_summary: This patch modifies the nfsd kernel module to check for a fine-grained time before clamping a delegated mtime (last modification time). If the mtime is past the coarse time, it will be clamped against a fine-grained time instead. This ensures that the client's reported changes are not lost when the server's clock is behind the client's clock. The patch also raises the mgtime floor for the file's ctime (last change time) to prevent later stamps from appearing older than they actually are.
